findings.title: 检测到持续低帧率
findings.evidence: 22.4–35.0 秒的 14 个连续采样均低于 45 FPS，平均 9.9 FPS。
findings.suggestion: 复现同一操作并检查 CPU 时间、Draw Call 和资源加载记录；后台页或主动限帧也可能降低 FPS。

findings.title: 检测到长帧
findings.evidence: 140 个采样区间出现至少 50 ms 的长帧，最长 33613.2 ms；记录到 292 个慢帧。
findings.suggestion: 对照长帧时间点复现资源加载、实例化、布局或大量销毁操作。启动、切场景与后台恢复产生的长帧需要单独判断。

findings.title: 同场景快照对象数量净增长
findings.evidence: “手动快照 下午3:13:02” → “手动快照 下午3:36:52”：Node +120，Component +270，监听器 +174。
findings.suggestion: 确认两次快照位于相同业务状态、完成销毁与异步回调后采集。重复相同生命周期仍持续增长时，按对象 ID、节点路径和注册堆栈排查；单次增长可能是正常业务。

findings.title: 资源缓存增长且仍有引用
findings.evidence: 相同场景资源数净增 50，588 个跨快照缓存资源的 refCount > 0。
findings.suggestion: 对照资源 UUID、addRef/decRef 与 release 请求检查持有者。缓存存在或 refCount > 0 本身不代表泄漏，release 请求也不等于物理内存立即释放。

findings.title: 已销毁或长期离树对象仍可被观察到
findings.evidence: 最近快照中 7 个 Node、32 个 Component 已销毁或超过 30.0 秒未在场景树中出现，但弱引用仍可访问。示例：GameScene/Canvas/uiLayer/AutoSpinDialog；GameScene/Canvas/topLayer/ToastDialogView；GameScene/Canvas/main/BathalaIconAnimLayer/lightningAnimLayer/Lightning。
findings.suggestion: 检查对象池、全局数组、闭包及事件/Tween 的持有关系。对象池可能有意保留对象，GC 也可能尚未执行；请在同一业务状态下复测，并使用 Heap Snapshot 的保留路径确认。弱引用可访问本身不是泄漏证明。

findings.title: 已销毁目标仍有关联记录
findings.evidence: 最近快照发现 27 个关联已销毁目标的 Tween 或监听器记录。示例：uiLayer:transform-changed → Widget；uiLayer:size-changed → Widget；uiLayer:anchor-changed → Widget。
findings.suggestion: 检查 onDestroy 中的事件解绑、Tween.stop/stopAllByTarget 和跨场景对象持有。该记录表示采集器观察到的关联，需要结合注册堆栈与业务生命周期确认。

findings.title: 存在长期活动的 Tween / 监听器
findings.evidence: 841 个活动记录已超过 30.0 秒。长期运行的动画和全局事件可能是正常行为。
findings.suggestion: 优先检查临时界面注册的监听器和循环 Tween；全局系统或常驻节点的长期记录可作为正常基线。

capabilities.name: scene-objects
capabilities.detail: Current scene and persistent roots, including inactive nodes/components. Detached objects are observable only after first scene observation.

capabilities.name: weak-object-retention
capabilities.detail: WeakRef observation is a leak clue, not a retaining path or GC proof. Without WeakRef, detached/destroyed retention and global event-bus lifetime cannot be tracked.

capabilities.name: event-listeners
capabilities.detail: 3.8.x callback tables: current Nodes and EventTarget.on/once observed since startup; once/off/targetOff/removeAll are reconciled from actual tables. Custom Eventify buses can call trackEventTarget(). No DOM/custom-emitter coverage.

capabilities.name: active-tweens
capabilities.detail: 3.8.x ActionManager._hashTargets inventory. Includes existing actions; completed/stopped actions are removed at next sample. Private-field compatibility is checked.

capabilities.name: js-heap
capabilities.detail: Chromium performance.memory usedJSHeapSize when available. Shared/isolate JS heap estimate; unavailable on most native/mobile runtimes. Native RSS and GC retaining paths are not measured.

capabilities.name: gpu-counters
capabilities.detail: Current engine device drawCalls and memoryStatus textureSize/bufferSize. Engine allocation counters, not total GPU process memory.

capabilities.name: resource-lifecycle
capabilities.detail: Observed after startup: assetManager.loadAny, assetManager.loadRemote, assetManager.loadBundle, Bundle.load, Bundle.loadDir, assetManager.releaseAsset, assetManager.releaseAll, assetManager.releaseUnusedAssets, Bundle.release, Bundle.releaseAll, Bundle.releaseUnusedAssets, Asset.addRef, Asset.decRef. Missing/unpatchable APIs: none. Nested load/release calls are deduplicated. Release events are API requests, not proof of reclamation.

capabilities.name: bounded-recording
capabilities.detail: Samples ≤ 1800; resource events ≤ 2000; object records ≤ 10000; snapshots ≤ 10. Call stacks are disabled. Frame percentiles use up to 6000 frames per interval. Observer adds scan/hook/serialization overhead.
